refresh_cadence: daily check; a concluded event's pairings are immutable and reused from the previous snapshot
records_captured: per-player running record at the time of the round
known_risks: Rate-limiting/ToS posture for sustained scheduled access not independently verified
Junior and Senior division matches have no MunchStats roster counterpart, so they cannot be resolved to a team_id
Player identity joins on (name, country), which upstream may spell inconsistently between the pairings and roster feeds

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: RK9 event identifier; identical to MunchStats' tournament id and this dataset's tournament_event.event_id

fields.name: pod_id
fields.description: RK9's numeric pod identifier for the division (pod numbering is not stable across events; join on division instead)

fields.name: division
fields.description: Human division label as printed on the pairings tab strip, e.g. "Masters", "Senior", "Junior"

fields.name: round_number
fields.description: Swiss/top-cut round number, 1-based

fields.name: table_number
fields.description: Physical table the match was played at; blank for a bye, which is assigned no table

fields.name: player1_name
fields.description: Player seated in the first cell, as printed by RK9

fields.name: player1_country
fields.description: Two-letter country code for player 1; blank when RK9 reports none

fields.name: player1_wins
fields.description: Player 1's match wins as of this round, from the printed (W-L-T) record

fields.name: player1_losses
fields.description: Player 1's match losses as of this round

fields.name: player1_ties
fields.description: Player 1's match ties as of this round

fields.name: player2_name
fields.description: Player seated in the second cell; blank for a bye, where there is no opponent

fields.name: player2_country
fields.description: Two-letter country code for player 2; blank for a bye or when RK9 reports none

fields.name: player2_wins
fields.description: Player 2's match wins as of this round

fields.name: player2_losses
fields.description: Player 2's match losses as of this round

fields.name: player2_ties
fields.description: Player 2's match ties as of this round

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Derived structurally from the winner/loser cell classes: player1_win | player2_win | tie | bye

fields.name: is_complete
fields.description: Whether RK9 marked the match container complete; an in-progress round reports false

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: Provenance: originating source name

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Provenance: the exact pairings round URL this row was read from

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Provenance: event/pod/round/table/player-1 composite; a bye has no table number, so player 1 disambiguates it

fields.name: extracted_at_utc
fields.description: Provenance: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the extraction run

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Provenance: dataset version this snapshot was staged toward
